explication: This is OpenTelemetry for Dart: an API and SDK for creating telemetry and propagating trace context. The documented trace workflow is to configure and register a tracer provider with processors and exporters, obtain a tracer, start and end spans, and optionally record events or errors. Context can flow within a process through Context or Zones, and across processes through text-map propagation. The tree also shows metrics, a logs API (logs are documented as unimplemented), sampling, resources, and web-specific timing. Source excerpts were unavailable, so links beyond README-documented relationships are omitted.
